author: reek
body: Stage 5 soundness tripwire for the flagship. The MyCons step of reverse (reverse xs) === xs cannot be closed by `cong ih` alone -- the goal reduces to reverse (append (reverse t) (MyCons h MyNil)) === MyCons h t, which is NOT `f (reverse (reverse t)) === f t` for any f; it needs the reverse-append lemma first. Offering only `cong ih` leaves an append/reverse mismatch, so the subgoal check must reject with CDX2001. If it were accepted, the checker would be unsound.
